scripts.dev:
[ -x .venv/bin/uvicorn ] || { printf 'Backend environment not set up. Run: cd apps/backend && python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
' >&2; exit 1; }; .venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --reload
scripts.lint:
[ -x .venv/bin/ruff ] || { printf 'Backend lint dependencies are missing. Run: cd apps/backend && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
' >&2; exit 1; }; .venv/bin/ruff check .
scripts.test:
[ -x .venv/bin/pytest ] || { printf 'Backend test dependencies are missing. Run: cd apps/backend && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
' >&2; exit 1; }; .venv/bin/pytest
